findings.title: Service shares host namespaces
findings.description: pid: host (or ipc: host) drops process/IPC isolation: the service sees and can signal host processes and shares IPC with the host. Keep the default PID and IPC namespaces. (Host networking via network_mode: host is AEGIS-COMPOSE-009.)
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Docker and CIS Docker Benchmark best practices. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, least privilege, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Service uses host network namespace (network_mode: host)
findings.description: network_mode: host removes network isolation entirely: the service shares the host's network stack, sees all host interfaces and traffic, and binds host ports directly — port publishing and network policies do not apply. Publish explicit ports on the default bridge network instead. (Split out of AEGIS-COMPOSE-003, which now covers host PID/IPC namespaces only: host networking is a distinct exposure.)
findings.expected: published ports on the default bridge network
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Docker and CIS Docker Benchmark best practices. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, least privilege, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
